fixed_mcs_uplink.title: Fixed MCS for Uplink
fixed_mcs_uplink.description: Forces PUSCH MCS (range 0 to 28). The MCS Table used is qam256

fixed_mcs_downlink.title: Fixed MCS for Downlink
fixed_mcs_downlink.description: Forces PDSCH MCS (range 0 to 28). The MCS Table used is qam256

tx_power_offset.title: TX Power Offset
tx_power_offset.description: Offset between Amarisoft SDR50 board power and ORS power. For fine tuning the reference signal power value. Default depends on ORS frequency, please refer to the connection parameters
